definitions: To separate or remove something from a larger piece or whole by cutting.
To interrupt or stop the supply or flow of something.
To isolate or separate someone or something from others.
To discontinue a relationship or communication with someone.
To prevent someone or something from continuing or progressing.
examples: They had to cut off the dead branch.
The storm cut off the power.
He felt cut off from his friends.
She decided to cut off contact with him.
The new regulations will cut off further development.
